runs.name: openapi-final
command: cd ../.. && npm exec --yes --package=@redocly/cli@2.71.1 -- redocly lint contracts/openapi-v2.yaml --format=json

runs.name: final-go
command:
set -euo pipefail
[[ -z "$(gofmt -l .)" ]]
go mod verify
go test -json -count=1 ./...
go test -race -json -count=1 ./...
go vet ./...
go build ./...
python3 ../../scripts/check-boundaries.py
go test -race -json -count=1 -tags=integration -p 1 -timeout=30m ./...
go vet -tags=integration,scale,p7capacity ./...
echo 'FULL_REVIEW_FINAL_GO=PASS'

runs.name: compose-regressions
reproduction_command:
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
fixture_dir=$(mktemp -d)
export RAI_COMPOSE_PROJECT_LOG="$fixture_dir/projects"
: > "$RAI_COMPOSE_PROJECT_LOG"
trap 'rm -rf -- "$fixture_dir"' EXIT
# Keep repository dev configuration unchanged. Only these three fresh test
# projects receive a private override with a newly generated credential each.
docker() {
 if [[ "${1:-}" == compose ]];then
  local full_review_project="${RAI_PROJECT:-${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:-}}"
  if [[ -n "$full_review_project" ]];then printf '%s\n' "$full_review_project" >> "$RAI_COMPOSE_PROJECT_LOG";fi
  if [[ "${2:-}" == -f && "${3:-}" == deploy/dev/compose.yaml ]];then
   command docker compose -f deploy/dev/compose.yaml -f "$RAI_TEST_COMPOSE_OVERRIDE" "${@:4}"
   return
  fi
 fi
 command docker "$@"
}
export -f docker
for phase in p3-e2e p4-compose p5-compose;do
 export RAI_TEST_COMPOSE_OVERRIDE="$fixture_dir/$phase.json"
 python3 - "$RAI_TEST_COMPOSE_OVERRIDE" <<'PY'
import json,secrets,pathlib,sys
password=secrets.token_hex(24)
dsn='postgres'+'://rai_dev:'+password+'@postgres:5432/rai_dev?sslmode=disable'
value={'services':{'postgres':{'environment':{'POSTGRES_PASSWORD':password}},'api':{'environment':{'RAI_DATABASE_URL':dsn}},'worker':{'environment':{'RAI_DATABASE_URL':dsn}}}}
p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]);p.write_text(json.dumps(value));p.chmod(0o600)
PY
 bash "../../scripts/test-$phase.sh"
 echo "FULL_REVIEW_COMPOSE_PHASE=$phase PASS"
done
RAI_SOURCE_COMMIT=0308b8658adc304040e445bc7f6ab61d212472d3 bash ../../scripts/test-p7-compose.sh
echo 'FULL_REVIEW_COMPOSE_PHASE=p7 PASS'
while IFS= read -r project;do
 [[ -z "$(command docker ps -aq --filter "label=com.docker.compose.project=$project")" ]]
 [[ -z "$(command docker volume ls -q --filter "label=com.docker.compose.project=$project")" ]]
 [[ -z "$(command docker network ls -q --filter "label=com.docker.compose.project=$project")" ]]
done < <(sort -u "$RAI_COMPOSE_PROJECT_LOG")
echo 'FULL_REVIEW_COMPOSE_CLEANUP=PASS (all owned projects, containers, volumes and networks absent)'
